summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new flower grade system features. All 7 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend features verified: Grade inputs on grower submission form, Grade filter buttons in catalog sidebar, Grade badges on strain cards, Grade Breakdown section in strain detail modal, Grade display in admin submissions view, Grade edit fields in admin strain edit form, and Grade Distribution panel in admin analytics Global Insights tab.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: POST /api/grower/submit accepts grade_a_kg, grade_b_kg, grade_c_kg Form fields (float type)
✅ Backend: Admin can view submission with grade breakdown via GET /api/grower/submissions
✅ Backend: Approving submission creates strain with grade_a_kg, grade_b_kg, grade_c_kg values
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{strain_id} can update grade_a_kg, grade_b_kg, grade_c_kg fields
✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/strain-directory/csv includes 'Grade A (kg)', 'Grade B (kg)', 'Grade C (kg)' columns
✅ Backend: GET /api/analytics/global returns grade_distribution in supply section (submissions + catalog totals)
✅ Backend: Zero grades (0) are handled correctly (stored as null)
✅ Frontend: Grower submission form (/submit-strain) has 'Flower Grade Breakdown' section with Grade A, B, C inputs (data-testid: grower-grade-a-input, grower-grade-b-input, grower-grade-c-input)
✅ Frontend: Catalog filter sidebar has 'Flower Grade' section with Grade A, B, C filter buttons (data-testid: filter-grade-a, filter-grade-b, filter-grade-c)
✅ Frontend: Filtering by Grade A shows only strains with grade_a_kg > 0 (tested: 3 of 29 strains)
✅ Frontend: Strain cards display grade badges (A: Xkg, B: Xkg, C: Xkg) with colored styling when grades are set
✅ Frontend: Strain detail modal shows 'Grade Breakdown' section with colored grade boxes (green/gold/gray)
✅ Frontend: Admin submissions view shows grade breakdown boxes for submissions with grade data
✅ Frontend: Admin edit strain form has Grade Breakdown section with Grade A, B, C input fields (data-testid: edit-strain-grade-a, edit-strain-grade-b, edit-strain-grade-c)
✅ Frontend: Admin analytics Global Insights tab shows 'Grade Distribution' panel with submissions totals (Grade A: 117kg, Grade B: 145kg, Grade C: 58kg)
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test submissions with grade data during backend tests: TEST_Grade_Strain_*, TEST_Approved_Strain_*, TEST_Zero_Grade_*. Also created test user accounts for frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flower grade system fully implemented and working. Key data-testids: grower-grade-a-input, grower-grade-b-input, grower-grade-c-input (submission form), filter-grade-a, filter-grade-b, filter-grade-c (catalog sidebar), edit-strain-grade-a, edit-strain-grade-b, edit-strain-grade-c (admin edit form). The Jealousy strain has been updated with grades (A: 12.5kg, B: 8kg, C: 4.5kg) and is a good test reference. Grade filtering works - clicking Grade A filter shows only strains with grade_a_kg > 0. Analytics global endpoint returns grade_distribution with both submissions and catalog totals.
